newsitem.title: USA: Physician says some units earned Q4 profit.
newsitem.headline: Physician says some units earned Q4 profit.

text.p: Physician Corp of America said Monday that its 1996 fourth quarter operations, excluding results of its workers compensation subsidiary - PCA Property and Casualty Insurance Co - are expected to earn pre-tax between $3.0 to $4.0 million.
The company declined to speculate what results will be including the subsidiary.
Actual results are expected to be released later this week, the company said.

Earlier this month, the company said it expected to take a charge of about $80 million in its fourth quarter due to increased liabilities associated with the subsidiary. It had already taken a $130 million charge for the same subsidiary in November.

The company on Monday said it is "pleased with the progress" in its core operations and was "both surprised and disappointed with the additional estimated losses incurred by the subsidiary, which are still under review."
The company said its banks granted a waiver of the covenant default on its loan, which was caused by the occurrence of the additional estimated losses.
